headline: Binance Users Withdraw $3.6 Billion Following Record Crypto Hack
summary: Users withdrew $3.6 billion from Binance after a record crypto hack impacted $6.3 billion worth of digital assets. The exchange froze transactions following the incident.
why: Binance is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and large-scale withdrawals or security breaches can create liquidity strains and heightened regulatory scrutiny across the digital asset market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Major exchange security incidents and large withdrawals tend to negatively impact broader crypto market sentiment and asset prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The security breach impacting billions in digital assets and subsequent transaction freezes triggered massive user withdrawals, weighing on investor confidence.
